name: Morning: Istighfar (100x)
arabic: ((أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ)) (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).

transliterations.latin: Estagfirull-llahe ve etubu ilejhi. (100 herë në ditë).

translations.albanian: Kërkoj faljen e Allahut dhe tek Ai pendohem.
translations.english: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’ [one hundred times a day]
translations.indonesian: Aku memohon ampunan kepada Allah dan bertaubat kepada-Nya.
